title: Effect of zero-valent iron on the structure and functional genes of autotrophic microflora in chromium-contaminated soil
description: Several types of zero-valent iron materials with different particle sizes were used to remediate chromium-contaminated soil, and the changes in the structure and functional genes of autotrophic microflora in the soil were analyzed during the remediation process.
samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from activated sludge metagenome
